description: This file contains unit tests for the InvestorBusinessEventSerializer class, specifically testing the serialization of LoanOwnershipTransferBusinessEvent objects into Avro DTOs with various statuses and sub-statuses.

classes.name: InvestorBusinessEventSerializerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the serialization logic of InvestorBusinessEventSerializer with various transfer statuses and sub-statuses.

methods.name: testSerializationSellOK
methods.description: Tests serialization of a standard SELL transfer with ACTIVE status.

methods.name: testSerializationBuybackOK
methods.description: Tests serialization of a BUYBACK transfer with BUYBACK status.

methods.name: testSerializationIntermediarySaleOK
methods.description: Tests serialization of an INTERMEDIARYSALE with ACTIVE_INTERMEDIATE status.

methods.name: testSerializationBuybackIntermediateOK
methods.description: Tests serialization of a BUYBACK transfer with BUYBACK_INTERMEDIATE status.

methods.name: testSerializationDeclinedNegativeBalance
methods.description: Tests serialization when the transfer is DECLINED due to BALANCE_NEGATIVE sub-status.

methods.name: testSerializationDeclinedBalanceZero
methods.description: Tests serialization when the transfer is DECLINED due to BALANCE_ZERO sub-status.

methods.name: testSerializationDeclinedPendingIntermediateNegativeBalance
methods.description: Tests DECLINED with BALANCE_NEGATIVE sub-status and PENDING_INTERMEDIATE status.

methods.name: testSerializationDeclinedPendingIntermediateBalanceZero
methods.description: Tests DECLINED with BALANCE_ZERO sub-status and PENDING_INTERMEDIATE status.

methods.name: testSerializationCancelledSameDayTransfer
methods.description: Tests CANCELLED transfer with SAMEDAY_TRANSFERS sub-status and PENDING status.

methods.name: testSerializationCancelledPendingIntermediateSameDayTransfer
methods.description: Tests CANCELLED transfer with SAMEDAY_TRANSFERS sub-status and PENDING_INTERMEDIATE status.

methods.name: doTest
methods.description: Helper method executing the serialization test with given statuses, verifying the resulting DTO fields and custom data.

methods.name: createMockCharges
methods.description: Creates mock LoanCharge instances for testing.

methods.name: loanCharge
methods.description: Creates a mocked LoanCharge with specified id, name, and outstanding amount.

methods.name: verifyFields
methods.description: Verifies that the serialized ByteBufferSerializable correctly maps to expected field values.

methods.name: verifyUnpaidCharges
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of unpaid charge data in the serialized result.

methods.name: createExternalAssetOwnerTransfer
methods.description: Creates a mock ExternalAssetOwnerTransfer object with specified status and sub-status.

methods.name: createTransferData
methods.description: Creates a sample ExternalTransferData object with specified status and sub-status.

methods.name: createCustomDataForEvents
methods.description: Creates a list of custom serializers for embedding additional custom data into the serialization output.
